title: Add named MCP tool profiles
description:
Problem: MCP enablement is currently controlled by raw enabled/disabled tool-name lists. That works for precise overrides, but it does not give operators a first-class way to select intent-based profiles such as read-only, proposal-only, local-admin, or external-safe modes.

Desired outcome: support named MCP tool profiles or modes that map to curated tool sets while preserving existing per-tool override behavior.

Scope:
- In scope: define profile concepts, configuration shape, precedence with existing enabled/disabled lists, and at least one safe default profile.
- In scope: expose the active profile in diagnostics or documentation so operators can verify runtime posture.
- In scope: add tests for profile resolution and explicit override behavior.
- Out of scope: redesigning the entire security-role model.

Validation:
- Focused configuration tests for profile resolution order and effective tool set.
- Docs updated with supported profile names, intent, and override rules.

Confidence target: 82%.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from MCP surface review because raw enabled/disabled name lists are workable but lack intent-based profiles such as read-only, proposal-only, or admin-local modes.
